The '''''Iso-One''''' was the wreck of a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] owned by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Reom]], the [[President/Legends|president]] of [[IsoTech]], and was his secret headquarters after the loss of his previous base on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].
